استأهلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْهَلُوا (istaʔhalū) /is.taʔ.ha.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# اِسْتَأْهِلُوا (istaʔhilū) /is.taʔ.hi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
